'''Lan Fellov''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Lan (star)|Lan]] in the [[Lan system]].<ref name="LB" /> It was situated within the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> and had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. As with all worlds of the Lan [[Star system/Legends|system]], except for the planet [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]], Lan Fellov was incapable of supporting life and featured a barren, rocky surface.<ref name="LB" />

The planet was extremely [[Ore/Legends|ore]]-rich, which led to its discovery by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime<ref name="LB" /> around [[1300 BBY/Legends|1300 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Lan Barell (article)|Lan Barell]]" dates the discovery of the [[Lan system]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to around 1,300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]], which equates to around [[1300 BBY/Legends|1300 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Soon thereafter, the [[Gaminne Group, Inc.]]&mdash;a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] conglomerate&mdash;purchased the system's mining rights from Lan Barell's [[Homeworld/Legends|natives]], the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]], and began exploring it, shipping ore from underground mining colonies to many resource-poor systems. The Qieg and the Human colonists eventually formed a stable government, the [[Human-Qieg Guild]], administrating the entire system. The system would eventually come under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], although the latter lacked an official presence there. By that time, mining operations continued on Lan Fellov.<ref name="LB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lan Fellov was first mentioned in "[[Lan Barell (article)|Lan Barell]]," a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first installment]] of the [[West End Games]] magazine ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The article was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and released in [[February]] [[1994]].<ref name="AdventureJournal">{{JournalCite|1|Lan Barell (article)}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Lan system, and therefore the planet Lan Fellov, in grid square O-18.<ref name="TEA" />
